$comment: FirstLight provider & source registry — the single machine-readable source of truth for provider statuses and terms. README tables, docs/PROVIDER_STATUS.md, and the demo UI Guide tab are generated from (or import) this file. 'verifiedInRepo' means a test in this repository exercises the implemented path; anything else is explicitly labeled. Never hand-edit generated outputs — edit this file and re-render.
statusVocabulary: live — adapter implemented, called by tests with real endpoints
blocked — adapter implemented, credentials required and absent
fixtures-only — adapter implemented against fixtures, no live acquisition
catalog-only — metadata/catalog discovery implemented, no asset processing
candidate — researched lead, NOT implemented, access not verified

modeLegend.publicDemo: what the static GitHub Pages demo can do
modeLegend.localPilot: what the server-backed local pilot does when run with credentials
modeLegend.deployedService: whether any public operational deployment exists (none does)

implemented.dataRole: hazard metadata — earthquake magnitude/location/time; NOT building damage
implemented.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey Earthquake Hazards Program
implemented.notes: Live adapter with retries/timeout/SSRF allowlist. Earthquake metadata are never converted to damage claims.

implemented.dataRole: official alert polygons/text — NOT damage assessment
implemented.notes: Alerts are authoritative for warning text; they are not flood outlines and not impact measurements.

implemented.dataRole: river discharge forecasts — NOT flood outlines
implemented.notes: Discharge values are not flood polygons, depth, or damage. The adapter records them as hazard context only.

implemented.dataset: STAC catalog discovery for Sentinel-1/2 products
implemented.dataRole: catalog metadata — listing is not an acquisition
implemented.license: Copernicus Sentinel data: free, full and open access under the Copernicus data licence / Data Space legal notice
implemented.notes: DISCOVERY ONLY: a catalog result is not an acquired image, and no raster processing exists (worker reports blocked_scaffold). Registering/authenticating for asset download is the documented next step — not done here.

implemented.dataRole: road/facility context — passability is NEVER implied
implemented.notes: Facility presence from OSM says nothing about post-event status; status stays unknown until authoritative/field confirmation.

implemented.dataRole: context leads — always unverified until corroborated
implemented.license: per-source; feed items carry their own terms
implemented.notes: OSINT items are leads, never evidence of facility status or casualty counts.

implemented.dataRole: thermal anomalies — NOT confirmed fire perimeters
implemented.notes: Honest blocker: credentials absent. Even when live, a thermal anomaly is not a fire perimeter.

implemented.publicDemo: synthetic illustrative grid (clearly labeled, NOT WorldPop data)
implemented.notes: Population figures are modelled estimates of where people live — never 'people currently present', never casualty counts.

implemented.publicDemo: not connected (demo sensor entries are illustrative metadata only)
implemented.notes: Adapter contract tested; no live acquisition possible without credentials.

implemented.publicDemo: not connected (demo sensor entries are illustrative metadata only)
implemented.license: event-release terms — verify before derivative/commercial use

implemented.notes: No scraping; API only, terms respected.

candidates.dataset: Sentinel-1 SAR GRD, Sentinel-2 MSI L2A — asset download + processing
candidates.status: candidate — catalog discovery live; asset download/processing NOT implemented
candidates.researchedTerms: Sentinel data free/full/open per Copernicus data licence; attribution 'contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [year]'; registration required for API/OData access
candidates.whyValuable: Cloud/day-night-resilient SAR + optical for event-specific observations; enables a reproducible real-data pilot
candidates.ownerNextAction: Register account, verify OAuth client-credentials flow server-side, download one dated scene with checksum, then build raster pipeline seam

candidates.dataset: DSWx-S1 (30 m surface water from Sentinel-1), DSWx-HLS (from Landsat/S2)
candidates.researchedTerms: NASA open data; products contain modified Copernicus Sentinel data; access via Earthdata login + CMR/PO.DAAC
candidates.whyValuable: Official product-level surface-water classifications with granule/time/quality metadata — distinguishes provider product from FirstLight derived change
candidates.ownerNextAction: Earthdata account + CMR granule search for AOI/date; verify product docs for mask semantics; integrate as observed source layer

candidates.status: candidate — access not verified (account review + product order + FTP route not tested)
candidates.researchedTerms: UNKNOWN until tested: registration review, product ordering, API/automation, quotas, retention, attribution, redistribution, commercial rights
candidates.whyValuable: Additional optical/microwave coverage and cadence for AOIs of interest
candidates.ownerNextAction: Register, order one test product for an AOI/date, and seek written answers on API/automation, delivery, quotas, attribution and commercial rights; otherwise leave 'candidate / access not verified'

candidates.status: candidate — portal availability/product availability for AOI+date not verified
candidates.researchedTerms: UNKNOWN until tested: account rules, bulk/API access, delivery timing, license/reuse rights, image metadata
candidates.whyValuable: Broad screening/context imagery at moderate resolution
candidates.ownerNextAction: Verify portal works, find products for a target AOI/date, test account + download route, and obtain written reuse terms; screening-only use (not building-level)

candidates.status: candidate — discovery index only; per-dataset access/license must be checked
candidates.researchedTerms: per-dataset: not all ISPRS-linked datasets share access or licensing
candidates.ownerNextAction: Pick one dataset page; verify bands, resolution, dates, label semantics and exact terms before any training use

candidates.dataset: pre/post disaster imagery with building damage labels
candidates.researchedTerms: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike); underlying imagery terms add further restrictions — a commercial-use gate
candidates.whyValuable: The canonical building-damage benchmark for research
candidates.ownerNextAction: For any commercial path, replace with commercially-clear imagery/labels; benchmark scores are never event validation

candidates.dataset: Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2 chips with surface-water labels
candidates.status: candidate — research/retrospective evaluation only; access/terms not re-verified from this repo
candidates.researchedTerms: access and current terms must be re-verified before use
candidates.ownerNextAction: Re-verify current hosting, license, and split semantics before training/eval use

candidates.researchedTerms: per-asset: acquisition date, footprint, resolution, license and availability vary per upload
candidates.whyValuable: Post-event UAV imagery discovery where it exists
candidates.ownerNextAction: Inspect each asset's date/footprint/resolution/license before use; skip assets without acceptable coverage/rights
Verify current terms + AOI coverage before integrating

candidates.researchedTerms: NASA open data / UCSB CHIRPS terms (verify before use)
candidates.ownerNextAction: Verify terms + latency + resolution; integrate as hazard context only

deployedServiceStatus.statement: No public operational deployment of FirstLight exists. The GitHub Pages site is a static simulated exercise; the operational mode is a locally-runnable, server-backed pilot only.
